body:
This is a cautionary tale for anyone who wants to try inhalants. I found some aerosol dust remover in the basement. I had read up on inhalants and decided I would just try it once. I took a hit - didn't feel anything. I took a deeper hit and felt amazing. It didn't last long, so I thought I'd take three deep breaths of it. Next thing I know I'm being lifted off from the ground by my mom. She said I had a seizure and broke a bunch of glass on the walls. My body was cut up. I'm lucky it wasn't much worse. My parents demanded to know what I took, so I told them. They threatened to kick me out of their lives and never see me again. It's NOT worth the few seconds of alternative feelings, trust me. I will never do it again.
